title: Every new relay command edits bin/relay
what: A relay command lives in its own module and is found by bin/relay (discovery), with its usage line next to it; adding a command touches no shared file.
why: Owner, 26 Oct: "агенты позволяют нам делать множество изменений одновременно, большие файлы - наши враги, концентрируя большой объем кода (смысла) они являются поводом для конфликтов", then "a" (principle 10 "one subject per file, no hub files, no copies" plus four items). Measured over 5 days: bin/relay (887 lines) in 44 commits, lib/relay_queue.py (1189 lines) in 25 commits kept in 3 copies, lib/relay_setup.py (1134 lines) changed by 3 open branches at once (license, setup-wt, the portable-tool design). IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen). bin/relay was in 44 commits in 5 days, the most of any code file.
failing_case: Adding a command today means editing bin/relay's table and usage text, so two branches that each add a command conflict there.
pass_cases: A test adds a command module in a temporary copy and bin/relay runs it and lists it in its help without bin/relay changing; every existing command behaves as before.
where: bin/relay (887 lines: the command table and usage)

said: У нас уже была задача на исправление команды help, должен быть встроенный механизм автоматического включения команды в help, так устроены все библиотеки для cli утилит, также необходимо добавить проверку на соответствие в review

fact: Live case, 30 Oct: `relay metrics` (landed 29 Oct) and `relay queue release` are missing from help; the front did not find metrics and built a manual collector instead. Front decision (owner can reverse; principle 5, fact to code): that a command is listed is checked by code (the item's pass case, in the gate); the review check the owner asked for goes into the judge base as "a change to a command's behaviour or options updates its usage line; a usage line that no longer matches the code is a finding", the part that needs reading.

said: Думаю что впоследствии в README.md будут содержаться только одна команда установки с подписью INSTALLATION
relay --help выдаёт информацию о дочерних командах, setup, queue, land
relay <command> --help выдаёт информацию о конкретной дочерней команды с её опциями и флагами

И так далее, я хочу чтобы ты понял мысль которую я доношу, вероятно ты знаешь это лучше меня, полагаю что именно так сейчас и есть, тебе лишь надо проверить текущее состоянии и выдать мне отчет о том как это устроено сейчас

fact: Measured 30 Oct: `relay --help` prints 90 lines, a flat list of 35 command forms with their arguments (not one line per command); `relay <command> --help` prints that command's slice of the same hand-written text (queue 43 lines, check 23, setup 7, gate 7, bench 6, land 4), forms and flags on one line, no per-flag lines; 20 commands in bin/relay's dispatch table, `metrics` missing from help, and `relay metrics --help` prints the whole top-level help instead. README.md is 120 lines.

30 Oct, trial of relay on a copy of relay cleaned of relay: `relay setup --help` prints the whole `relay --help` (rc 0), no setup-specific help, though the 30 Oct survey listed setup's own 7-line slice; the command has no help of its own when reached through the dispatcher in that form.
